change_summary: Rewrite only the get_order_details tool description in filter_tools to instruct issuing multiple order lookups as a single parallel batch.
reason_for_change: Multi-order tasks (54/103/8/20) drive high turn counts (38/35/33/25) via 3-6 sequential get_order_details calls, each a separate round-trip generating a full-context billed turn. Prompt-level batching hints were rejected, so this modifies the mechanism directly at the tool-description level: signaling the lookups are independent and batchable encourages parallel tool calls in one turn, collapsing round-trips and cutting billed generation turns/tokens per task. It leaves the system prompt/policy and verification flow untouched, so success stays at floor while mean cost drops on the multi-order tasks that dominate turn count.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.7500 < floor 0.7521
hypothesis: The agent re-fetches get_order_details one order at a time (40 calls total, 5-6 per multi-order task like 54/103/8/20) but the model already reasons over addresses/items; instructing the agent in the harness tool descriptions to fetch all candidate orders in a single parallel batch reduces round-trip turns.
